snippet.title: Lumo Idle Park gameplay preview
snippet.description:
This is a gameplay demonstration of my idle game developed.

The game is inspired by Sonic Adventure DX and Chao Garden, featuring:
- conveyor-based idle mechanics
- fruit collection and upgrades
- relaxing and satisfying progression

The game is currently in closed beta testing.
If you'd like to try it and help shape the game, you can apply here:
https://forms.gle/BbNfk55oH3qgmexa8

Your feedback is extremely valuable and will directly influence future updates.
